paragraphs.text: Cursor integration for DeepSeek Harness (DSH): cursor_agent tool, OpenAI-compatible cursor-agent bri
dge, and an LLM provider probe.
# DSH Cursor Toolkit

Three small pieces that let DeepSeek Harness
(DSH) use Cursor:
| package | what it is |
| `@qyjqio/dsh-cursor-cli` | DSH host plugin adding the **`cursor_agent`** tool — hands a coding tas

k to the local `cursor-agent` CLI and returns its final message plus chat id (resumable). |
| `@qyjq
io/cursor-openai-bridge` | OpenAI-compatible HTTP server backed by `cursor-agent`, so Cursor models

can be registered as a normal DSH **LLM provider**. |
| `@qyjqio/dsh-llm-probe` | Diagnostic tool th
at lists the provider routes a **running** DSH process registered and runs one real streamed call —
useful because a Session's subagent policy is frozen at start. |

They are independent: install the bridge + probe if you only want Cursor models
inside DSH's model p

icker; install the CLI tool if you want an agent that edits
files in a workspace.
## Why a bridge instead of direct API access

Cursor exposes no OpenAI-compatible endpoint (`/v1/models` → 404); inference runs
over a private con

nect/protobuf API. Wrapping the official CLI keeps auth,
model routing and the agent loop in Cursor'

s own hands, and keeps this repo
small and dependency-free.
